**Given Data:**
- Rating = $100\text{ kVA} = 100,000\text{ VA}$
- Full load copper loss ($P_{cu}$) = $1300\text{ W}$
- Iron loss ($P_i$) = $800\text{ W}$
- Power factor ($\cos \phi$) = $1$ (Unity)

**1. Total Losses at Full Load ($P_{\text{loss}}$):**
$$P_{\text{loss}} = P_{cu} + P_i = 1300 + 800 = 2100\text{ W}$|

**2. Output Power ($P_{\text{out}}$):**
$$P_{\text{out}} = \text{kVA rating} \times 1000 \times \cos \phi = 100,000 \times 1 = 100,000\text{ W}$|

**3. Efficiency ($\eta$):**
$$\eta = \frac{P_{\text{out}}}{P_{\text{out}} + P_{\text{loss}}} \times 100 = \frac{100,000}{100,000 + 2100} \times 100 = \frac{100,000}{102,100} \times 100 = 97.94\%$|
proTip: Always convert kVA to Watts by multiplying by 1000 when adding power losses which are in Watts.
